episodes.title: Inside the Cult of Elon Musk | True Lives
episodes.description:
From Tesla to Twitter, Elon Musk has become the most influential businessman ever, but it required the masses to support his seemingly unreachable visions - the cult behind the man.

Subscribe to True Lives: https://bit.ly/3dBMxvl

Cult of Elon follows the story of Musk and Tesla’s success, examining his path to becoming one of the most influential, and controversial, businessman by creating an immensely powerful cult of personality.

This film was first broadcast: 2023
